title: Single-writer PR ordering and bounded CI observation; independent AI release evidence
detection: Repeated Required run observations, bottlenecks and main drift must be measured from provider identity
root_cause: Provider ordering alone does not express evidence-qualified sync priority; run repetition can be misread as safely skippable
correction: Pure advisory ranks existing PR snapshot; keeps existing required-gate lease CAS on authority; precise repeat grouping; paired job measurements; AI evidence hold
prevention_rule: Never infer safe sync, duplicate test to skip or AI production approval from an advisory or partial sample
independent_proof: Pending exact-head protected Required, CodeQL, provider run and post-merge observation
reuse: Existing Janitor, CI Intelligence, Recovery Supervisor, quality admission and canonical memory; no new scheduler
